# Practical checklist

Model: `checklist-rail`. Each call creates a complete slide. Inter, geometry and text sizes are fixed.

[Model index](../../../templates/MODELS.md) · [Palette and content guide](../../STUDIO-MODELS.md)

```latex
\studiosetup{palette=light}
\studiotemplate[variant=default]{checklist-rail}
```

Palette switches are available only where the original composition exists in both colours.
Unsupported explicit choices fail. A global palette leaves special compositions in their native treatment.

## Variants and named fields

### default

Original palettes: blue.

[Current source](../../../templates/studio/checklist-rail.tex) · [Full slot guide](../guides/checklist-rail.md)

| Field | Default | Available space |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label-one` | <code>\textbf{Step 1}\\{\fontsize{36\studiounit}{43\studiounit}\selectfont Supporting detail.}</code> | 40.8% wide × 9.5% high |
| `label-two` | <code>\textbf{Step 2}\\{\fontsize{36\studiounit}{43\studiounit}\selectfont Supporting detail.}</code> | 40.8% wide × 9.5% high |
| `title` | <code>Title</code> | 20.5% wide × 15.6% high |
| `label-four` | <code>\textbf{Step 4}\\{\fontsize{36\studiounit}{43\studiounit}\selectfont Supporting detail.}</code> | 40.8% wide × 9.5% high |
| `label-five` | <code>\textbf{Step 5}\\{\fontsize{36\studiounit}{43\studiounit}\selectfont Supporting detail.}</code> | 40.8% wide × 9.5% high |

Omitted fields retain these descriptive defaults; empty values retain their allocated space. Numbers and charts are illustrative.

## Complete one-slide example

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  variant={default},
  palette={blue},
  label-one={\textbf{Step 1}\\{\fontsize{36\studiounit}{43\studiounit}\selectfont Supporting detail.}},
  label-two={\textbf{Step 2}\\{\fontsize{36\studiounit}{43\studiounit}\selectfont Supporting detail.}}
]{checklist-rail}
\end{document}
```
